bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks and backpack-style purses are prohibited unless they are clear. Permitted bags and clear backpacks may not exceed 13 by 15 inches, and all bags are searched.
allowed: Permitted bags no larger than 13 by 15 inches
Clear backpacks no larger than 13 by 15 inches
bagPolicy.note: One personal food item in a clear disposable non-glass container and one empty or factory-sealed water bottle are generally permitted, subject to show-specific exceptions.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Merriweather Post Pavilion can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Merriweather Post Pavilion's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Merriweather Post Pavilion offers a variety of food options including sandwiches, wraps, pizzas, and salads. Highlights include the Merriweather Deluxe Cheeseburger, Steak Frites, and a selection of vegetarian options like the Impossible Cheeseburger and Falafel Pita. Guests can also enjoy snacks like seasoned curly fries and nachos.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: ADA accessible parking is available in Lots 2 and 4. Wheelchair-accessible and companion seats are located throughout Section 100, in Row Z of Sections 200-204, and in Row JJ of Sections 300-302.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Merriweather Post Pavilion's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Tickets can also be purchased in person from the Merriweather Post Pavilion box office, as well as The Anthem, Lincoln Theatre, and 9:30 Club box offices, and at 9:30 The Truck. They are also available in person at 9:30 Club, The Anthem and the Lincoln Theater box offices.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For most performances, the show starts 90 minutes after gates open.
